findings.problem: The line "This date applies to personalized and engraved pieces too." directly contradicts brand/voice.md, which says not to claim personalized/engraved items ship within the same processing window as standard items unless the business has confirmed it. No such confirmation exists in the project; the campaign plan's 21-day lead-time math never accounts for extra personalization production time.
findings.fix: Remove the claim, or replace it with wording that flags personalized/engraved items may need an earlier cutoff (e.g. 'personalized and engraved pieces may need to be ordered a little earlier — we'll confirm'), per brand/voice.md.

findings.fix: Change to "fifth generation" (e.g. 'handcrafted by our artisans, fifth generation now, since 1880') to match documented brand vocabulary.
